confidence_notes: The [city price survey](https://fluxy.io/abroad/cost-of-living/jp/matsuyama-japan) has only three contributors, and some food checks postdate July 2026. Cocktail and wine estimates use their relationship to beer in a [local menu](https://brasserie-mika.com/drink/). Accommodation prices are holistic estimates; private-hostel availability and July weekends add uncertainty.
comparable_city_reasoning: Matsuyama is treated as a mid-sized regional Japanese city comparable to Takamatsu, with an allowance for visitor demand around Dogo Onsen.
